baselinePrompt: Add animated water and a controllable boat to this 2D web game. Make the water look good.

cases.goal: Improve a top-down body of water while preserving the existing boat and controls.
qualityChecks: water has readable depth at game scale
at least two motion scales do not synchronize
moving boat produces a directional wake
highlights do not obscure the boat
finished result is visibly preferable to the captured baseline

verification.note: A verified-useful badge requires controlled no-skill and with-skill runs on multiple fixtures.
